claim: The European Genome-phenome Archive is an external service for permanent archiving and sharing of personally identifiable genetic, phenotypic, and clinical biomedical research data under controlled access.
future_grounding_route: Specific EGA studies require access approval; only after approved download, hashing, and project preprocessing can they become grounded inputs.
project_use: Controlled-access genetics/phenotype data discovery and acquisition route mapping.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Controlled-access personally identifiable genetic, phenotypic, and clinical datasets not available in this public repository.
why_unverifiable: EGA records and datasets are externally governed, and many datasets cannot be accessed or rerun without approved data-access permissions.
